title: Central primitive idempotents as a complete system of bar-aware projections
html:
Corollary — complete system of bar-aware projections

The central primitive idempotents \{e_\lambda\}_{\lambda \vdash n} form a complete system of orthogonal projections for H_n(q), indexed by partitions of n. They are explicit (prop:explicit-central-idempotent) and bar-aware. Self-conjugate \lambda yield bar-fixed projections (real period witnesses). Conjugate pairs yield bar-swapped projections (chirality-twisted witnesses).
